name: Google Maps
note: Source is Google Maps' accessibility help page, which documents only this short list (it also mentions pressing Ctrl+/ inside the map to reveal a live shortcut overlay, but does not enumerate that overlay's contents in text, so nothing further could be extracted without inventing entries). Not expressible, so left out: plain arrow keys / Tab to move keyboard focus onto the map (no modifier, and Tab is generic browser focus traversal), and 'press a number 1-7 to learn about a numbered place' (the numbered places are dynamic per-search results, not a fixed single shortcut).
